intro: Taco Bell is the king of cheap, craveable Tex-Mex: crunchy tacos, Crunchwrap Supremes, Chalupas, burritos and nacho fries, washed down with a Baja Blast. The Cravings value menu and Cravings Boxes make it one of the best-value fast-food runs anywhere. Below is the full Taco Bell menu with prices and calories for 2026, organized by category.
quick_answer: Taco Bell is built for value. Crunchy and soft tacos start at $1.79, the Cravings value menu starts at $1.00, and the Build Your Own Cravings Box (two entrees, a side and a drink) is about $5.99. Signature items like the Crunchwrap Supreme ($5.29) and Cheesy Gordita Crunch ($4.99) cost a bit more.
hot_deal: Taco Bell value: the Cravings value menu starts at just $1.00 (Cheesy Roll Up), and the Build Your Own Cravings Box bundles two entrees, a side and a drink for around $5.99. The Luxe Cravings Box steps it up to about $7.00. Deals and limited-time items change often. Offers vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a taco at Taco Bell?
faqs.a: A Crunchy or Soft Taco is about $1.79, and the Supreme version with tomatoes and sour cream is around $2.59. Doritos Locos Tacos are about $2.59.

faqs.q: What is in the Taco Bell Cravings Box?
faqs.a: The Build Your Own Cravings Box is about $5.99 and includes two entrees, a side (like chips or Cinnamon Twists) and a medium drink, all your choice. The Luxe Cravings Box is around $7.00.

faqs.q: How much is a Crunchwrap Supreme?
faqs.a: The Crunchwrap Supreme is about $5.29. It layers seasoned beef, nacho cheese, lettuce, tomato and a crunchy tostada folded inside a grilled tortilla.

faqs.q: Does Taco Bell have a value menu?
faqs.a: Yes. The Cravings value menu starts at $1.00 for the Cheesy Roll Up, with most items between $1.00 and $2.00, including the Spicy Potato Soft Taco and Cheesy Bean & Rice Burrito.
Baja Blast is a tropical lime-flavored Mountain Dew sold only at Taco Bell. A regular is about $2.39, and the frozen Baja Blast Freeze is around $3.49.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Taco Bell?
faqs.a: The best known are the Crunchwrap Supreme, the Crunchy Taco Supreme, the Cheesy Gordita Crunch, Nachos BellGrande, and the Baja Blast Freeze.
